jobs.name: gpu-info
jobs.command: nvidia-smi | tee gpu-info.txt && nvcc --version | tee -a gpu-info.txt

jobs.name: train
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; PY=$(command -v python3); $PY -c 'import numpy' 2>/dev/null || $PY -m pip install --quiet numpy; $PY -B -m walk.train.gpu_train --envs 4096 --horizon 64 --updates 99999 --seed 917 --device cuda --library $(find experimental/duck_cuda -name 'libduck_cuda_fast.so' | head -1) --lane-env --policy ff --randomization '{"r_mass":0.1,"r_friction":0.2,"r_kp":0.1,"r_damping":0.2,"max_latency_steps":1}' --out gpu-train-out --lr 1.5e-4 --max-wall-s 2400 2>&1 | tee gpu-train.log
